flawed_step: Lines 31–33 incorrectly evaluate and compare the bound from line 29, so the stated conclusion does not follow as written.
counterexample: Substitute k=5 into the right-hand side of line 29: 8(k-1)/(k-4)=8·4/1=32, not 8·5/1=40, and certainly 32>2·1012=2024 is false. Moreover, even the asserted direction 'RHS > 2024' would not contradict the required inequality 2024≤RHS.
assessment_summary: The proof relies on a false numerical claim at line 31 to infer k≤4. The intended comparison was presumably 2024>32, but that is not what the proof states.
